messages:
maya: kicking off gradual feature-flag rollout for model-routing v3.3.0 in eu-west. starting at 5% -> hold 10m -> then 20% if healthy. release notes live: https://internal.releases/redwood/notes/2026-03-model-routing-v3.3 :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled flag 'model-routing-v3.3' -> region=eu-west target=5% at 12:00UTC. rollout-id=r-2026-03-20-01. will post status updates here.

jonah: on watch. I'll create a temporary p95 alert at 200ms and a trace link for long tails. ping me if it crosses 200ms for >1m.

sachin: quick question about rollback behavior: if we need to revert, do we full-pin back to v3.2.1 and route cohorts to dedicated-pool, or just pause the ramp? need clarity for runbook.

elaine: runbook checklist: 1) pause ramp (deploy-bot pause) 2) pin flag -> previous stable version v3.2.1 3) enforce routing override to dedicated-pool for affected cohorts 4) scale canary pool + open incident if metrics don't recover in 2min. I'll own the incident if triggered.

sre_oncall: infra looks steady pre-rollout. GPU queue depth 48% and node health green. I'll set a soft cap: if GPU queue >80% for 3m, throttle new canaries.

maya: deploy-bot, add holdpoint at 5% for 10m and auto-rollback criteria: error_rate>0.5% for 2m OR p95>300ms for 2m. also tag release with notes mentioning possible long-sequence latency.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: holdpoint added at 5% for 10m. Auto-rollback rules attached: (error_rate>0.5% over 2m) OR (p95>300ms over 2m). Notifications: #eng-releases + page oncall if triggered.

jonah: seeing a small p95 blip to ~270ms and errors 0.18% — still below thresholds. traces look concentrated in long-seq requests. continuing to monitor. :mag:

maya: if holdpoint clears, proceed to 20% then 50% ramp windows with 15m soak each. prefer quiet window for full cutover tonight 00:00-02:00 UTC.

sachin: regarding pin automation — when pinning back we should ensure routing override for pinned cohorts is atomic. I'll push a helper script:

```
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/v1/flags/pin
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN"
  -d '{"flag":"model-routing-v3.3","version":"v3.2.1","scope":"eu-west","force_routing_override":true}'
```

maya: perfect. that matches runbook step 2. please add a small wait-and-verify after pin (30s checks for error_rate and p95).

elaine: I'll update the release notes copy: "Gradual rollout of model-routing v3.3.0 to EU-West with auto-rollback to v3.2.1. Known limitation: slight latency increase on >1024 token requests; monitor token-level latency metrics."

sre_oncall: adding metric queries and alerts: `sum(rate(requests_total{env=prod,region=\"eu-west\"}[1m])) by (cohort)` and p95 alert. paging channel on rule hit.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: moving to 20% per schedule at t+10m. rollout status: 5% -> healthy. next holdpoint set for 15m at 20%.

maya: noted. thanks everyone — call out immediately if any auto-rollback triggers so we can run the pinback script and start incident runbook. :thumbsup:
